findings.current: The twenty rescued Hunters remain unconscious but alive inside the Skeleton King’s reinforced bone barrier; the Mutated Gate’s final status is unresolved.
findings.defect: This continuity entry stops at chapter 557 and contradicts chapter 558, where the Hunters have been evacuated, Lee Seungyeop awakens in an ambulance, and Song Song confirms that every member of his team survived.
findings.rationale: Active continuity must reflect the latest chapter in the checkpoint rather than preserve an already resolved cliffhanger.
findings.replacement: The Forest of Giants encounter has ended, and all twenty rescued Hunters survived and were evacuated; Team Leader Lee Seungyeop later awakened in an ambulance and learned that every member of his team was safe.

findings.current: The second and final form of the Blazing Flame Divine Spear, which concentrated three hundred years of the Fire Gate Clan’s macho spirit—the time-honored clan with absolutely no concept of retreat.
findings.defect: The parent technique changes from Fire Dragon Divine Spear earlier in the same chapter to Blazing Flame Divine Spear when its second and final form is introduced.
findings.rationale: Calling Heavenly Strike the second and final form establishes that it belongs to the same technique whose first form, Fire Dragon’s Single Tail, was identified as part of the Fire Dragon Divine Spear.
findings.replacement: The second and final form of the Fire Dragon Divine Spear, which concentrated three hundred years of the Fire Gate Clan’s macho spirit—the time-honored clan with absolutely no concept of retreat.

findings.current: This necklace was not Lee Jungryong, nor was it a keepsake he had left behind.

findings.rationale: The replacement restores the intended distinction without changing the established fact that the necklace was neither Lee’s property nor his keepsake.
findings.replacement: This necklace had not belonged to Lee Jungryong, nor was it a keepsake he had left behind.
findings.source: Chapter 555, Go Jun examining the necklace
